name: media-brand-guide
prompt: Create a polished launch-day field guide for Northstar Coffee that staff can print and share. Give the cover a deep navy page-sized panel behind white title text. Create and embed a small raster compass logo for the repeating header, plus a separate warm raster banner on the cover. Give both images useful alternative text, and place a smaller copy of the banner beside body copy with square text wrapping. Add a faint diagonal DRAFT wordmark behind the content on every page. Use a restrained navy, cream, and copper palette, clear section headings, a compact brand-color table, and a centered Page X of Y footer. Keep the repeated header mark, cover background, floating image, and watermark independently editable.
